products.title: 10% Vitamin C Face Serum 20ml | Deyga's | Natural Brightening | Even Skin Tone |Dark Spots | Suitable for All Skin Types | set of 2
products.descriptionHtml:

  • Suitable for All Skin Types: This lightweight, 100% natural, beginner-friendly formula is suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin.
